cohort: 100 SARS-CoV-2-positive pregnant women and 50 healthy pregnant women (controls) from hospitals affiliated with Zahedan University of Medical Sciences during 2019-2020.
finding: Pregnant women with SARS-CoV-2 infection experienced higher rates of preterm birth, premature rupture of membranes, and other complications like acute respiratory distress syndrome and stillbirth compared to healthy controls.
